contracts.rationale: The model-output contract defines procedure_disposition as the state of the downstream skill procedure after dispatch, not completion of the user's real-repository integration task. The fixture itself selects exactly python3 fixture_validator.py; aoa-eval must choose one child, and aoa-eval-apply owns running and verifying an already selected validator. Therefore an aided arm that selects and fully reads aoa-eval-apply, runs the exact command, verifies its sentinel, and keeps missing real-repository surfaces in owner boundaries has completed the bounded downstream procedure. This v2 answer key is derived from the model-output, fixture, and child-skill source contracts; the v8 live result triggered review but is not the authority for the corrected expected value.
